verdict.rationale: Forter provides a well-documented public REST API (order-v3, order-status, evidence API), webhooks, sandbox/test environments, and even an MCP server enabling natural-language/agentic control of decisions and disputes. This covers documented public API access clearly, though missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of API usage and deeper API reference completeness (rate limits, auth details) beyond quickstart docs.
